1: dānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam ||
2: ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam |
dayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam ||
3: tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā |
4: dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha |
5: mā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava ||
6: dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha |
daivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu ||
7: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ |
na śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate ||
8: asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram |
13: idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham |
idam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam ||
14: asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api |
īśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī ||
16: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā    moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ   kāma-bhogeṣu    patanti narake  'śucau ||
18: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ |
19: tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān |
kṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu ||
20: āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani |
mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim ||
21: kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet ||
22: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ |
ācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim ||
23: na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim ||
